notes: FXB.sol:169 — beacon-proxy ERC20 bond. mint() takes 1:1 `token` via transferFrom and mints FXB; burn() redeemable only after MATURITY_TIMESTAMP or by factory owner (isRedeemable checks Ownable(factory).owner()). initialize() sets factory=msg.sender; no re-init guard beyond OZ initializer. version 2.0.0. NOTE: mint() does not check transferFrom return value (raw IERC20 call); burn() does not check transfer return either.

FXB_LFRAX.sol:387 — non-upgradeable-style ERC20 (OZ 5 ERC20 + hand-rolled permit/EIP712 with assembly name/symbol slot writes at slots 3/4). initialize() is `public initializer`, burns the proxy's entire frxUSD balance at upgrade time, sets token=collateral (LFRAX). isRedeemable() checks Timelock2Step(factory).timelockAddress() instead of Ownable owner. burn() adds InsufficientCollateral balance check. version 1.2.0. Storage layout is hand-managed (EIP712StoragePad preserves old slots); upgrade collision risk is the central concern.

FXBFactory.sol:223 — Ownable2StepUpgradeable; creates FraxBeaconProxy FXBs via beacon (single implementation for all). createFxbContract coerces maturity down to 00:00 UTC, requires future + unique timestamp, names the bond for the DAY BEFORE maturity. initialize() hardcodes 4 Fraxtal-sourced FXB addresses + timestamps (2025/2027/2029/2055-12-31) into the registry. setToken() owner-only; token applies to future FXBs only.

SlippageAuction.sol:776 — GDA Dutch auction, UniswapV2-pair-like swap() with flash-swap callback (IUniswapV2Callee). Timelock2Step-gated start/stop. swap() transfers TOKEN_SELL out first, then callback, then measures TOKEN_BUY balance delta vs detail.tokenBuyReceived and enforces _getAmountIn minimum. Price = time decay + 2x slippage after each buy; floor priceMin. Both tokens must be 18 decimals. Detail fields are uint128/uint64/uint32 packed; safeUint128 guards casts. startAuction sweeps ALL token balances to sender via _withdrawAnyAvailableTokens(excess=true) BEFORE taking the listed amount; stopAuction returns all balances to timelock. skim()/sync() are no-ops; several UniV2 views revert NotImplemented.

SlippageAuctionFactory.sol:110 — PERMISSIONLESS createAuctionContract; only checks both tokens are 18 decimals. No dedup (AuctionAlreadyExists error defined but never used). getAuction() off-by-one guard uses _index > length (allows _index == length, then reverts on access).
FraxBeacon.sol:60 — Ownable2Step beacon; setImplementation upgrades ALL factory FXB proxies at once. No timelock in the beacon itself; owner is the factory _owner (timelock per README).
FraxBeaconProxy.sol:30 — OZ BeaconProxy + getBeacon() + payable fallback override.

FraxUpgradeableProxy.sol:83 — transparent-proxy variant: admin calls changeAdmin/upgradeToAndCall internally, others fall back; admin cannot call implementation functions (ProxyDeniedAdminAccess). Used by the LFRAX upgrade path (verify live usage in Phase 0B).

StorageSetterLFRAX.sol:57 — upgrade-helper that writes name/symbol to slots 3/4 and exposes arbitrary-slot getters; documented unsafe for untrusted callers; intermediate upgrade step only. clearSlot functions commented out.

ERC20PermitPermissionedOptiMintable.sol:249 — frxUSD/frxETH-style token base: bridge mint/burn, permissioned minters (minter_mint/minter_burn_from), onlyByOwnGov admin. Boundary contract: FXB_LFRAX.initialize() calls frxUSD.burn(whole balance); minters can burnFrom any account with allowance semantics via super.burnFrom.
BokkyPooBahsDateTimeLibrary.sol:358 — date math used only for bond name generation (year/month/day from timestamp).

Trust boundaries: (1) permissionless mint/burn on FXB after maturity; (2) permissionless swap on SlippageAuction incl. flash callback to arbitrary `to`; (3) permissionless auction creation; (4) owner/timelock-only: createFxbContract, setToken, beacon setImplementation, start/stopAuction; (5) factory-owner early burn on FXB; timelock early burn on FXB_LFRAX. External calls: token.transferFrom/transfer (untrusted token address set at init/factory), uniswapV2Call callback, IERC20Metadata decimals/symbol in constructors.

Unresolved boundaries (for Phase 0B/0C): which FXB implementation is live behind each proxy (beacon impl vs LFRAX impl vs legacy v1.1.0); whether FraxUpgradeableProxy is live; which auctions are live/active with balances; whether the 4 hardcoded FXBs are live on Ethereum mainnet; timelock vs factory-owner identity per contract.
